title: Poorly Located Interior Controls and Vents
summary: Reviews in this topic mainly describe hard-to-find or poorly placed interior controls and vents, with a few broader problem mentions and too little detail in some fragments to unify every example cleanly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews are scarce and mainly say the car had no problems, while one positive-labeled fragment references another brand's unresolved Apple CarPlay issue rather than a clear G70 strength.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on poorly located or difficult-to-use interior light, vent, seat, and screen controls, plus a few broader problem reports with limited detail.

mixed.summary: Mixed reviews pair otherwise favorable impressions with complaints that vents and climate controls are hidden, awkwardly placed, or badly redesigned.

signal_notes.interpretation: BEVE examples in this topic are all negative or mixed, and the sampled fragments within that group emphasize poorly located vents and controls.
ICE examples also skew negative or mixed, with sampled fragments centering on difficult interior light, vent, seat, and display controls.

limitations: Several fragments are very short or generic problem statements, so some examples do not provide enough detail to identify the exact issue.
The cluster includes both specific control-placement complaints and broader problem mentions, so it is not perfectly coherent as a single narrowly defined issue.
The sampled examples are stratified and not representative estimates of all G70 reviews.
